meta.title: 提前感受拉花冠军的氛围
meta.title_en: A Peek Into the Latte-Art Champion's World
meta.topic: 咖啡 · 拉花冠军访谈

scenes.context: 庄老师采访拉花冠军刘强，先寒暄再直奔主题——请对方现场制作自己夺冠的图案。
sentences: 今天很荣幸能够拍到刘强老师制作拉花的部分。
It's a real honor today to film Mr. Liu Qiang making latte art.
a real honor（很荣幸）
那等一下要做什么图案？可不可以看一下你的那个冠军的那个图案？
What design shall we do in a moment? Could we see the design you won the championship with?
the championship-winning design（夺冠图案）
paraphrase: The pattern that took the title.
scenes.speak: It's a real honor today to film Mr. Liu Qiang making latte art. What design shall we do in a moment? Could we see the design you won the championship with?

scenes.context: 拉花豆子选深烘焙、新鲜的。深烘焙油脂丰富、线条稳定、不易晕染；浅烘焙拉花困难、对比度差。
sentences: 做拉花还是要烘焙度相对深一点的好用，然后可以新鲜一点。
For latte art you want a roast that's relatively dark, and as fresh as you can get.
a relatively dark roast（相对深一点的烘焙）
深一点的话它的油脂会更加丰富，线条会更稳定，不容易出现晕染或者糊掉。
A darker roast gives richer crema and steadier lines, so the pattern won't bleed or blur.
richer crema（更丰富的油脂）
浅烘焙的豆子拉花就会比较困难一点。
Light-roasted beans make latte art noticeably harder.
light-roasted（浅烘焙的）
paraphrase: Dark roasts hold the line better.
scenes.speak: For latte art you want a roast that's relatively dark, and as fresh as you can get. A darker roast gives richer crema and steadier lines, so the pattern won't bleed or blur. Light-roasted beans make latte art noticeably harder.

scenes.title_en: Extraction: 20 Grams, Sized to the Cup
scenes.context: 萃取多少克都能拉花，但为好用，冠军习惯萃20克。比例关系不看那么细，主要看杯型——300ml杯配20克，小杯更少。
sentences: 萃取多少克其实都是可以去做拉花的，但为了让拉花更好用，我自己习惯萃取20克。
Any dose can work for latte art, but for a friendlier shot I usually pull 20 grams.
pull a shot（萃取浓缩）
会考虑到杯型，今天用的是300毫升的杯子，那我的浓缩就会在20克左右。
I do consider the cup — today's 300 ml cup takes around 20 grams of espresso.
around 20 grams（20克左右）
如果杯子比较小的话，浓缩就可以适当的再小一点。
If the cup is smaller, I scale the espresso down accordingly.
scale down（相应调小）
paraphrase: A dose that's easier to work with.
Let the cup size drive the dose.
scenes.speak: Any dose can work for latte art, but for a friendlier shot I usually pull 20 grams. I do consider the cup — today's 300 ml cup takes around 20 grams of espresso. If the cup is smaller, I scale the espresso down accordingly.

scenes.title_cn: 奶温：看油脂与图案难度
scenes.title_en: Milk Temperature: Read the Crema and the Design
scenes.context: 奶温不固定：油脂好用或图形简单→奶温高一点；油脂难用或图案复杂→低一点点。
sentences: 如果油脂比较好用或者图形比较简单，就可以高一点。
If the crema behaves well or the design is simple, go a touch higher.
behave well（好操作/好用）
如果油脂没有那么好用，或者是图案比较复杂，低一点点。
If the crema is tricky or the design is complex, go a bit lower.
a bit lower（低一点点）
paraphrase: It's a dial, not a fixed number.
scenes.speak: If the crema behaves well or the design is simple, go a touch higher. If the crema is tricky or the design is complex, go a bit lower.

scenes.context: 上帝视角拍摄拉花，完成的正是2019年夺冠的经典凤凰图案。对比度=底色干净+线条清晰分明；底色不一定要深，但一致性必须高。
sentences: 这是第一次拿冠军、2019年的比较经典的一个凤凰的图案。
This is the classic phoenix design from my first title, back in 2019.
a classic phoenix design（经典凤凰图案）
对比度就是底色要干净，然后线条要清晰分明。
Contrast means a clean base and crisp, clear lines.
crisp lines（清晰的线条）
不一定要让底色颜色很深很黑，但是底色的颜色的一致性必须很高。
The base doesn't have to be very dark, but its consistency has to be very high.
consistency of the base（底色一致性）
paraphrase: Contrast is clean base plus sharp lines.
Evenness of the base matters more than darkness.
scenes.speak: This is the classic phoenix design from my first title, back in 2019. Contrast means a clean base and crisp, clear lines. The base doesn't have to be very dark, but its consistency has to be very high.

scenes.context: 白色线条的小瑕疵，比赛严格会扣分但现实常忽略。要接受评审的扣分——精益求精；赛前训练要提前规避小瑕疵。
sentences: 这一点点在比赛里面严格来说就会扣，但实际当中可能会忽略。
Strictly speaking, a tiny flaw like this loses points in competition, though in practice it might be ignored.
lose points（扣分）
如果评委要扣你的分数，你也要接受，因为你是精益求精。
If the judges dock you, you accept it — that's the pursuit of perfection.
the pursuit of perfection（精益求精）
赛前训练的时候就要严格要求自己，就要把那些小瑕疵都要规避掉。
During pre-competition training you hold yourself to a strict standard and eliminate those small flaws.
eliminate small flaws（规避小瑕疵）
scenes.speak: Strictly speaking, a tiny flaw like this loses points in competition, though in practice it might be ignored. If the judges dock you, you accept it — that's the pursuit of perfection. During pre-competition training you hold yourself to a strict standard and eliminate those small flaws.

scenes.context: 初学者问题集中在浓缩与奶泡：选豆不了解、流速标准偏慢不能快、萃完浓缩才打奶泡是错误习惯（要同时处理）、奶泡打好必须立刻拉花防分层。
sentences: 萃取流速我们都会控制在要么是标准流速，要么是标准偏慢，绝对不能快。
We keep the extraction flow at standard or a touch slower — never fast.
a touch slower（标准偏慢）
萃完浓缩之后才去打奶泡，这个就是错误的习惯，要保证浓缩跟奶泡是同一时间去处理好。
Frothing the milk only after pulling the shot is a bad habit — the espresso and milk should be ready at the same time.
a bad habit（错误习惯）
奶泡打好了之后必须要立刻去拉花，一定不能等，等一会它就会分层。
Once the milk is frothed you must pour immediately — waiting even a little lets it separate.
the milk separates（奶泡分层）
paraphrase: The foam falls apart if you wait.
scenes.speak: We keep the extraction flow at standard or a touch slower — never fast. Frothing the milk only after pulling the shot is a bad habit — the espresso and milk should be ready at the same time. Once the milk is frothed you must pour immediately — waiting even a little lets it separate.

practice.q: 「拉花用深烘焙新鲜的豆子」怎么说？
practice.a: For latte art, go with a relatively dark, fresh roast.
Pull 20 grams, scaled to the cup size.

practice.q: 「底色干净+线条清晰=对比度」怎么说？
practice.a: Contrast means a clean base and crisp lines.

practice.q: 「奶泡打好要立刻拉，等会就分层」怎么表达？
practice.a: Pour right after frothing — waiting lets the milk separate.

pitfalls: Use light-roasted beans for latte art.
Choose a dark roast, as fresh as possible.
Light roasts bleed and blur — rich crema holds the line.
Pull the shot first, then froth the milk.
Prepare espresso and milk at the same time.
Frothing after the shot lets the crema sit and the milk wait, hurting the pour.
Set the same milk temperature every time.
Adjust by crema quality and design complexity.
Easy crema/simple designs take higher heat; tricky ones take lower.
Pour immediately once the milk is ready.
Sitting milk separates and the foam goes coarse.
shifts: 拉花失败就怪手法，豆子随便用
先锁豆子/萃取/奶温/时机四环，手法最后谈
